name: Museu Etnográfico da Praia
subtitle: The Ethnographic Museum stands on Rua 5 de Julho in the Plateau.

facts.label: Collections
facts.value: Traditional costumes, pottery, cloth weaving and basketry

facts.label: Language work
facts.value: Each 21 February the museum promotes Creole for International Mother Language Day

parts.text: The Ethnographic Museum stands on Rua 5 de Julho in the Plateau. It opened in 1997 to preserve and publicise traditional heritage such as costume, pottery, cloth and basketry.
